lineage.preimplementation_source_encoding_amendm: Auxiliary P80 B reward channel masked before R45 implementation because unequal observable state tags otherwise reveal hidden gate through reward; original freeze-only snapshot retained in ancestry; current file's Git blob is the controlling protocol.

hypothesis.primary: A learned content-selective reader must use an observable B record tag to distinguish a causal signal from an equal-and-opposite selected distractor impulse when the position-blind pooled B observation is identical for opposite latent gates.
hypothesis.secondary: The mechanism should generalize from 8-step to 16-step factual histories with randomized cue/distractor positions and physical-dynamics shift, using only selected observations; compare independent seeded GRU and content-only controls.
hypothesis.native_specific: An independent Native backbone advantage must survive backbone removal and strongest fully trained matched conventional control; otherwise claim only an ordinary learned conditional selection mechanism.

identification.cue_decoy_position: Two distinct positions drawn by hash of panel/group/salt; identical across matched opposite-gate worlds; not exposed as model metadata.
identification.physical_observation: For each selected B record, obtain the public action key and normalized selected delta using _record(observed_state,selected_action,observed_state+selected_delta,context). Mask its auxiliary reward component effect[4] to a fixed zero for every B record before any learning/scoring; reward is outside this controlled B measurement task and otherwise leaks gate through unequal tag states. Preserve the selected physical-delta sensor, immutable action key and all other fixed channels.
identification.selected_public_cue: B selected key encodes role state 0.42, not the latent gate. Competing selected decoy role state 0.18 also visible.
identification.measured_B_effect_indices: Only normalized physically selected state-change channel effect[0] varies; auxiliary reward effect[4] is deterministically zero, and all other channels remain unchanged, across all B rows.
identification.balanced_mean_test: Compare full 16-channel means of B action keys and normalized B effects, paired gate +/- worlds for each group/panel. Require torch.allclose with atol=1e-7,rtol=0 on CPU and no label-conditioned aux-feature; cue and decoy impulses are exactly equal/opposite, with nuisance fixed by group.

source.early_fifth: Use separate genuinely selected R43 quartic fifth probe to identify q sign, with no hidden q access in model/loss; OOD uses R41 cubic return.
source.factual_loss: Train by actual separately selected physical return consequence; (decoded following state - goal)^2, no unselected action outcome in learner.
source.balanced_labels: Both context and q-sign and latent-gate signs present in equal numbers per group
source.negative_admission: External original F7, consumed R42/R43/R44 source, panel ID, generator group, hidden gate, q label, chosen or unchosen evaluation outcome cannot reach learner.

arms.name: native_selective
arms.summary: Genuinely learned B-key content attention and value readout, gated by frozen binder contrast and Native preaction signal without action bypass

arms.name: native_uniform
arms.summary: Same Native and readout with fixed uniform B weights; never receives selected position metadata

arms.name: gru_conventional
arms.summary: Fully trained GRU with B history and selected fifth, same FIT data and training updates

methods.reference: Explicit observable-state tag selector from actually selected B key; positive information-feasibility control, not proof of neural learning.
methods.binder: Replay original R38 factual binder on qualified original FIT only, frozen and fingerprint-verified, full replay compute included; no original F7 external source first-use.

training.whole_process_compute_capacity: Report measured CPU wall, trainable params, gradient norm, replay cost; no strict superiority unless matched compute/capacity established.

controls: blocked evaluator-only gate and cue index
same input mean for opposite gate
methods.output: 8 trained instances with paired CAL/OOD action vectors, acceptance factors and provenance; all failed results retained.

prospective_score.if_uniform_pool_succeeds: Treat as possible information leakage or nonlinear conditional computation, inspect observed means and do not claim learned selective weighting.
prospective_score.if_native_not_necessary: Credit selective contextual memory only; do not claim Native-specific AGI gain.
prospective_score.if_either_seed_no_fit: Optimization failure, no transfer pass even if one OOD score appears good.

qualification.mandatory: Exact SHA G4 full Windows/Ubuntu, G5 native TTT Windows/Ubuntu, G7 pinned Mamba2 Ubuntu, original artifacts/sha checks, per-decision cross-OS parity and rejection controls
qualification.claim_boundary: Engineering PASS != scientific PASS, all source-neutral tasks DEV only; independent original-world external first use separately authorized.
